title: Merge Intervals
description:
Given an array of intervals `[start, end]`, merge all overlapping intervals and return the non-overlapping intervals that cover all the input, sorted by start.

**Constraints**

- `1 <= intervals.length <= 10^5`
- `0 <= start <= end <= 10^6`
hints: Sort by start, then extend the last kept interval whenever the next one starts before it ends.
complexity: O(n log n) time, O(n) space

editorial.explanation:
Sort by start time. After that, an interval either overlaps the last one kept — in which case
extend that one's end — or it starts a new group.

Taking the maximum of the two ends matters: an interval can be entirely swallowed by the previous
one, and blindly assigning its end would shrink the result.

`O(n log n)` for the sort, `O(n)` afterwards.
editorial.complexity: O(n log n) time, O(n) space
